Third time re-writing my review. None of them have been positive.
I am a p2w player on blockade. I've got the megapack, armor, I'm level 33, I'm usually one of the people new players hate having to deal with. So if I'm still giving this a bad review, that should tell you something.
The great hacker wars have seemingly stopped. Last I heard PiotrK has stopped putting his hacks out for people to use, so it's a much nicer place to be again. That does NOT mean, however, that the game has become "good." It never was.

-=Major Problems=-

1) Rooms are unbalanced to shit. I know the playerbase has gotten a lot smaller than it was in the first year or so of blockades life, but that doesn't justify letting level 45's into a room full of level 1-10's so they can spam kill them until they quit and uninstall.

2) Tanks mode. You completely removed tanks for a couple months, I was hoping either to FIX it or to remove it for how unpopular it is, you did neither. You brought it back, and there are still random enemy players you cannot damage, tanks can still be glitched into so they act like invincible armor as the person "inside" runs around shooting their normal gun, and even the one non-tank vehicle you would expect to be fast (jeep) goes about the same speed as the light tank, and can only take two shells before fucking exploding. It's worthless to even have.

3) Armor piercing weapons and one-shot weapons. I love the M700. I love one-shotting people. But it can one shot people even when they're wearing the armor they had to pay to own, the armor they expect to protect them from instant deaths. Not to mention there is at least one other sniper rifle that just completely ignores armor, maybe more. If you're going to sell armor, make it prevent instant deaths. It should have done that from the beginning, since you have to pay just to have it.

4) RPGs. Anyone who's played for over 10 minutes has met those level 1's who can't aim a fucking gun to save their life, so they spam RPG's and Mortars like there's no tomorrow. They damage around 3 blocks on all sides of their impact block, they instantly kill you even if they hit the outside of a wall 2-3 blocks thick that you're on the other side of, they're broken and no one likes them. Area damage is fine and makes sense, but is it really that hard to make the damage lessen the further from your body it actually hits? You made bullets do less damage to the legs than the body, I know you're capable of it.

5) This one's just a personal pet peeve more than an actual issue but: Early Access. This game's been out at least 2 years and been on Facebook for probably longer. You wrote fucking 4-6 months in your game description. Stop lying and either finally admit you're too fucking lazy to impliment the major changes to repair game-breaking problems that everyone's been harping about (looking at you, Tanks Mode), or start adding new shit and change your description to say "We're never going to become a finished game, we're just too good at wasting time." Adding a holiday sale and an anti-cheat that banned people who lagged too hard does not count as new features.

EDIT: Upon attempting to revisit it for old times' sake, the game appears to be dead. No matches load, no rooms show up, nothing. A shame too, it seems like they'd fixed some of the things I had issues with between then and now.

I mean, what can i say. Yet another minecraft clone. This may appeal to the average 10 year old gamer, the kind of guy that doesn't know much about games and can't afford a game such as minecraft. Now to be brutally honest, for the average steam user and avid game enthusiast, this game would be considered a no-go. For what it is, this being a poorly made fps in an almost identical style to the popular game mincraft, some may say it "Does the job". As i was mentioning about an average game enthusiast, this just will not be what you are looking for. Weather it is the poor texture quality, moderate to average game modes, poor user interface and so on, the game is not great. Playing the game just feels clunky and not very smooth. Playing a well made game and then suddenly jumping to this, i can say the difference is evident. When you play a good game made by well known developers and play this, it feels quite horrific. The only time i can imagine playing this would be  of pure irony and not for the pleasure/enjoyment of the game. I can honestly say that i feel sympathy for those that play this game unironically. To sign off, i would say this game is 2/10. 2 being the fact that i can laugh about it with friends. The game is bad.

Blockade 3D is a FPS shooter/builder game. It is Free, and its fairly fun. The game is really simple, you pick your guns, you spawn in then you kill stuff for levels and try and capture a point. and thats it. Or tanks, which is basically the same thing, only with tanks. The game is fun, but the problem lies with the Pay to Win feel to it, as helmets make the game infinately harder, and the fact that people can have much better weaponry than you with lower levels is fustrating. The game is not bad by any stretch of the imagination, but its very very annoying sometimes. I reccommend playing it in bursts, or have a friend of yours install the game and constantly kill him for levels so you dont have to pay to play.
